kind: user-directed project policy, not an Apple numerical finding

authority.verbatim: 我觉得精度方面就是达到 99% 的效果已经可以接受了，不用追求像素级的还原可逆，因为我们掌握的信息也不算很全？

engineering_target: Useful, natural and stable separately controlled global/local/semantic reduction, then independent HDR rendering and RGB Gain Map; relative scene-linear remains a candidate.
interpretation_of_99_percent: Qualitative near-complete effect. No numerical accuracy, fraction of correct pixels, or pass is asserted.
deferred_as_engineering_blockers: 33-point globally tight inverse hull and complete C01-C05 certification
explaining S80 2.44140625e-4 synthetic tile residual merely to satisfy the old 1e-5 gate
complete per-pixel unique inversion and proof over all nonfinite/sampler paths
reopen_precision_research_only_if: An observed practical defect (visible seams, halos, hue shifts, unstable inverse or loss of important structure) requires it, or the user explicitly requests it.
legacy_evidence_policy: Keep frozen source, original gates, failures, masks and intervals. Deferred requirements do not turn into passed legacy checks.

practical_validation.common_preview: Reuse the same previously fixed ACES display transform and exposure for all comparisons; record implementation/settings SHA and verify source SHA before/after preview.
report_without_relabeling_as_accuracy: EV error median/p95/p99/max where a native/reference or a defined roundtrip exists; state denominator, near-black threshold, coverage and exclusions
whole-frame nonfinite/clamp/plateau counts and uncertainty masks; report excluded regions separately
edge halos, ringing, seams and smooth-ramp discontinuities, with full-size crops
skin hue/chromaticity change, target support versus background changes, and strength sweep
separate HDR target-to-carrier error and 8-bit map quantization error
full ImageIO decoded SDR max0 for the final new carrier
practical_validation.decision: Real-photo evidence plus visual review of the declared variants; quantitative limits must be declared for that suite before its holdouts, with no retroactive selection or hidden bad-pixel exclusions.

physical_claims.scene_referred_accuracy: Not inferred from natural appearance, high PSNR, roundtrip or a Gain Map.
physical_claims.j: Weight-ceiling bound is not pixel EV. Empirical amplitude remains a labeled conservative estimate until matched same-frame curves/statistics exist.
needs_device: matched j-only/WithoutFaceBoost curves and same-frame N/B/T/V/face histogram/allocateTone/application domain
